biggest_catch: The friend must set up a recurring direct deposit of at least $500 from a payroll or government source within 60 days - no DD, no bonus for either side.
catches: Referrer earns $100 for each referred individual who opens a new qualified Cash Rewards Checking or Interest Rewards Checking account within 60 days of being referred and registers for the offer.
Friend earns $100 when they open a qualifying account with a recurring direct deposit of at least $500 (payroll/government source) within 60 days of account opening.
Friend must also register to receive their reward.
ACH returned items, WSB-to-WSB transfers, and ATM/mobile check deposits do not qualify as direct deposit.
Only one referrer is eligible per referred person (first registration wins).
Allow 2-4 weeks for processing after all requirements are completed.
Rewards may be reported as income to the IRS.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.
